title: Scene Never Triggered in 30 Days
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=scene_activated
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by scene
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| where days_since>30
| sort - days_since
description: Lists scenes that have not fired in a month, helping you prune abandoned ideas and keep the smart-home configuration tidy.
value: Unused scenes create clutter and confusion; a stale-scene report turns the home-lab habit of cleanup into a household benefit.
implementation: Capture scene activation events; schedule monthly and archive scenes nobody has used in the past thirty days.
visualization: Inventory table of stale scenes with days since last activation.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which named scenes have basically gone unused for a month and are probably just clutter now.
